content.short: Kite AI is an L1 blockchain purpose-built for the agentic economy and autonomous AI agents.
content.description: Kite AI is a specialized Layer 1 blockchain designed to provide the foundational infrastructure for the emerging agentic economy. It empowers autonomous AI agents to operate, interact, and transact on-chain with native efficiency. By introducing 'Proof of Artificial Intelligence' (PoAI) and providing agents with verifiable cryptographic identities, Kite AI ensures that AI entities can securely access decentralized services and execute stablecoin payments. The protocol bridges the gap between AI development and execution in a transparent ecosystem.
